import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)

def mat(name, color, metal=0, rough=.4):
    m=bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.diffuse_color=(*color,1); m.use_nodes=True
    p=m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF'); p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*color,1); p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=metal; p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=rough
    return m

def finish(o,name,m,bevel=0):
    o.name=name; o.data.materials.append(m)
    if bevel:
        mod=o.modifiers.new('Soft manufactured edges','BEVEL'); mod.width=bevel; mod.segments=3
        o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def box(name,loc,size,m,bevel=.03):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=loc); o=bpy.context.object; o.dimensions=size
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False,rotation=False,scale=True)
    return finish(o,name,m,bevel)

def rod(name,a,b,r,m,vertices=48):
    a,b=Vector(a),Vector(b); d=b-a
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=vertices,radius=r,depth=d.length,location=(a+b)/2)
    o=bpy.context.object; o.rotation_euler=d.to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler()
    finish(o,name,m,.012)
    for f in o.data.polygons: f.use_smooth=len(f.vertices)==4
    return o

def beam(name,a,b,w,h,m):
    a,b=Vector(a),Vector(b); d=b-a
    o=box(name,(a+b)/2,(w,h,d.length),m,.05); o.rotation_euler=d.to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler(); return o

def cable(name,points,r,m):
    c=bpy.data.curves.new(name,'CURVE'); c.dimensions='3D'; c.bevel_depth=r; c.bevel_resolution=3
    s=c.splines.new('BEZIER'); s.bezier_points.add(len(points)-1)
    for p,co in zip(s.bezier_points,points): p.co=co; p.handle_left_type='AUTO'; p.handle_right_type='AUTO'
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,c); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o); o.data.materials.append(m)

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)

def mat(name,c,metal=0,rough=.4):
    m=bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.diffuse_color=(*c,1); m.use_nodes=True; p=m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF'); p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*c,1); p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=metal; p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=rough; return m

def box(name,loc,size,m,bevel=.04):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=loc); o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.dimensions=size; bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False,rotation=False,scale=True)
    if m: o.data.materials.append(m)
    if bevel:
        q=o.modifiers.new('Rounded edges','BEVEL'); q.width=bevel; q.segments=5
        o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def cyl(name,a,b,r,m,vertices=64):
    a,b=Vector(a),Vector(b); d=b-a; bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=vertices,radius=r,depth=d.length,location=(a+b)/2); o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.rotation_euler=d.to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler(); o.data.materials.append(m)
    q=o.modifiers.new('Edge radius','BEVEL'); q.width=.012; q.segments=3; o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=len(p.vertices)==4
    return o

def apply_all(o):
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=o
    for q in list(o.modifiers): bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=q.name)

def cut(o,tool):
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=o; q=o.modifiers.new('Open slot','BOOLEAN'); q.operation='DIFFERENCE'; q.solver='EXACT'; q.object=tool; bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=q.name); bpy.data.objects.remove(tool,do_unlink=True)

def path(name,pts,r,m):
    c=bpy.data.curves.new(name,'CURVE'); c.dimensions='3D'; c.bevel_depth=r; c.bevel_resolution=4; s=c.splines.new('BEZIER'); s.bezier_points.add(len(pts)-1)
    for p,co in zip(s.bezier_points,pts): p.co=co; p.handle_left_type='AUTO'; p.handle_right_type='AUTO'
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,c); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o); o.data.materials.append(m)

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)

def mat(name,c,metal=0,rough=.35):
    m=bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.diffuse_color=(*c,1); m.use_nodes=True; p=m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF'); p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*c,1); p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=metal; p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=rough; return m

def lathe(name,profile,m,n=128):
    verts=[(r*math.cos(2*math.pi*j/n),r*math.sin(2*math.pi*j/n),z) for r,z in profile for j in range(n)]
    faces=[]
    for k in range(len(profile)-1):
        for j in range(n):
            a=k*n+j; b=k*n+(j+1)%n; faces.append((a,b,b+n,a+n))
    mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); mesh.from_pydata(verts,[],faces); mesh.update(); o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,mesh); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o); o.data.materials.append(m)
    for p in mesh.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    return o

def box(name,loc,size,m,bevel=.04):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=loc); o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.dimensions=size; bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False,rotation=False,scale=True); o.data.materials.append(m)
    if bevel:
        q=o.modifiers.new('Edge radius','BEVEL'); q.width=bevel; q.segments=4; o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def rod(name,a,b,r,m):
    a,b=Vector(a),Vector(b); d=b-a; bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=64,radius=r,depth=d.length,location=(a+b)/2); o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.rotation_euler=d.to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler(); o.data.materials.append(m)
    q=o.modifiers.new('Machined edges','BEVEL'); q.width=.014; q.segments=3; o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=len(p.vertices)==4
    return o

def torus(name,loc,major,minor,m,rotation=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_segments=112,minor_segments=16,location=loc,major_radius=major,minor_radius=minor,rotation=rotation); o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.data.materials.append(m)
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    return o

def mat(name,c,metal=0,rough=.4):

    return o

def rod(name,a,b,r,m,n=48):
    a,b=Vector(a),Vector(b); d=b-a; bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=n,radius=r,depth=d.length,location=(a+b)/2); o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.rotation_euler=d.to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler(); o.data.materials.append(m)
    q=o.modifiers.new('Edge bevel','BEVEL'); q.width=.008; q.segments=3; o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=len(p.vertices)==4
    return o
